params.body:
## What

The transport overview (`/transports`) is now two screens, one per role.

**A garage reads one quiet table.** One line per transport: the car (make and model, the VIN small under it), the state as one word, the price, the date. At most one button, and only when the garage has to act: "Bevestig en betaal" or "Betaal". Where it has nothing to do the same place says in grey whose turn it is ("we vragen de prijs op", "we plannen de ophaling in"). Everything else is in the row menu: view, and cancel before payment, which still asks through `ui.confirm`. Above the table one sentence answers whether there is something to pay. No selection boxes, no bulk menu and no planning step in this view.

**The administrator reads the work in sections**, in this order:

1. **In te plannen**: paid, transport requested, pick-up confirmed. A selection box per row, one button at the head of the section that marks the selected rows as requested, pick-up confirmed or completed, and the step of a single transport in its row menu.
2. **Prijs ingeven**: requests that wait for a price from us, with "Prijs invullen" on each row (it opens the transport window, where the price is typed in).
3. **Afgerond**: completed and cancelled, folded.

The sentence on top counts the first two ("5 transporten in te plannen, 2 wachten op een prijs.").

Transports that wait for the garage (price available, price received, waiting for payment, and a request that was never finished) are not the administrator's work, so they get no main section. They stay reachable in one folded line at the bottom, "Wacht op de garage", so nothing becomes unfindable. Only the three sections were asked for; that line can be removed by deleting the `wait` entry in `TransportOverview::SECTIONS`.

## How grouping, paging, sorting and filtering work

- **The groups come from the query.** Each section is its own query on its states (`TransportRepository::getOverviewSection`), so a section is whole however many transports there are. There is no page of twenty mixed rows that then gets grouped.
- **Paging is per section.** A section lists its first 20 rows and its head says how many there are in all. "Toon nog 20" lengthens that one section (`?show[plan]=40`, at most 500). A `page` in the address moves nothing.
- **Sorting works inside every section.** "Sorteer op" orders the rows of each section; two sections never mix. Default: newest first.
- **The filters narrow every section alike.** A section without a match disappears, a folded section with a match opens, and the counts follow the filter (the "Gefilterd" chip says a filter is on).
- The garage's table keeps the paging it had: 20 per page.

## One open question, not decided here

R S4-10.11 lets the requesting dealer set the next planning step on its own transport, and the routes (`transport.update.next`, `transport.update.state`) still do. This pull request only takes the controls out of the garage's overview; the guards are untouched, and the transport window still offers the step. Whether the routes should close for a garage is a separate decision.

## Also

- R S4-10.23 holds on the new row: a request with one address twice gets no pay button and is not counted in the garage's answer.
- The price column has no second badge: a missing price is plain grey text ("in aanvraag").
- The date shows the day; the time is in the title.
- The styles moved into `resources/css/ui.css` (`ui-transport-*`, on the tokens of the design system). `refresh.css` only loses the one rule the old table used (the highlight of the row you return to from Mollie).
- The bulk menu left the page head (`header.blade.php`) for the section it acts on; `_row_buttons.blade.php` is gone, `_row.blade.php` replaces it. The orders truck (`_row_action`), the worklist and the transport window are not touched.
- The page no longer uses jQuery or `onclick=` for the bulk step, so the budgets in `tests/quality-ratchet.json` go down (onclick, jQuery, and the lines of `refresh.css`).
- New strings in nl, fr, en and de. Spanish was already behind on this file and is left as it was.
- Rules R S4-10.11, S4-10.13 and S4-10.21 describe the two views.

## Tests

`TransportOverviewRowsTest` is rewritten for the two views: the sections and which transport is in which, the folded line, the counts in the answer, the bulk step from the section head, the garage's table without planning controls, one action per row at most, cancel asking first, a section staying whole across more rows than it lists and under sorting, a filter opening a folded section, and the Gate. `ListPageHeadersTest` follows the bulk menu to its new place.

Locally: the full suite (2653 tests) is green, PHPStan reports no errors, pint passes on the new PHP file.
params.title: Transport overview per role: a quiet table for the garage, the work in sections for the administrator
